articles.summary: Regions outpaces regional and national banking peers, earning high marks for trust, relationships and digital banking experience in this nationwide study. Regions Bank on Thursday announced the company is ranked No. 1 in Overall Satisfaction in the JD Power 2026 U.S. Small Business Banking Satisfaction StudySM . The top ranking reinforces Regions’ commitment to helping small-business owners succeed through trusted relationships, personalized service and convenient banking tools and solutions. Regions Bank ranked No. 1 in Overall Satisfaction in the JD Power 2026 U.S. Small Business Banking Satisfaction Study. Regions scored above the industry average across nearly every dimension measured in the study. The results point to a banking experience built around accessibility, consistency and advice that helps small-business owners confidently make decisions.
